function main()
    deck = [string(rank, suit) for suit in "SHDC" for rank in "A23456789TJQK"]
    state = 2026
    for i = 51:-1:1
        state = state*48271 % 2147483647
        j = state % (i+1)
        deck[i+1], deck[j+1] = deck[j+1], deck[i+1]
    end
    for first = 1:13:52
        println(join(deck[first:(first+12)], " "))
    end
end

main()
